def design(feats):
    X = np.asarray(feats.x, float); y = np.asarray(feats.y, float); n, p = X.shape
    ids = list(feats.ids)
    labs = sorted(set(feats.stratum))
    S = np.ones((n, 1))
    if len(labs) > 1:
        S = np.column_stack([S] + [np.array([s == l for s in feats.stratum], float) for l in labs[1:]])

    def fit(Z):
        b = np.zeros(Z.shape[1]); ll = -np.inf
        for _ in range(50):
            eta = Z @ b; pr = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-eta))
            w = np.clip(pr * (1 - pr), 1e-9, None)
            g = Z.T @ (y - pr); H = (Z * w[:, None]).T @ Z + 1e-6 * np.eye(Z.shape[1])
            step = np.linalg.solve(H, g); t = 1.0
            while t > 1e-4:
                nb = b + t * step; ne = Z @ nb
                nll = np.sum(y * ne - np.logaddexp(0, ne))
                if nll >= ll - 1e-10: break
                t /= 2
            if nll - ll < 1e-8: b, ll = nb, max(nll, ll); break
            b, ll = nb, nll
        return ll

    def design_mat(sel, prods=()):
        cols = [S] + [X[:, [j]] for j in sel] + [(X[:, a] * X[:, b])[:, None] for a, b in prods]
        return np.column_stack(cols)

    R = np.corrcoef(X.T)
    sel = []; base = fit(design_mat(sel))
    gates = [0.01 / p, 0.02 / p, 0.01 / p]
    while len(sel) < MAX_DRIVERS:
        best, bj = -1, None
        for j in range(p):
            if j in sel or any(abs(R[j, k]) >= 0.6 for k in sel): continue
            g = fit(design_mat(sel + [j])) - base
            if g > best: best, bj = g, j
        if bj is None or stats.chi2.sf(2 * best, 1) > gates[min(len(sel), 2)]: break
        clus = [k for k in range(p) if k != bj and abs(R[bj, k]) >= 0.6 and k not in sel]
        if clus:
            cand = [bj] + clus; sc = {}
            for c in cand:
                llc = fit(design_mat(sel + [c]))
                sc[c] = (llc, sum(fit(design_mat(sel + [c, k])) - llc for k in cand if k != c))
            top = max(v[0] for v in sc.values())
            bj = min((c for c in cand if sc[c][0] >= top - 2), key=lambda c: sc[c][1])
        sel.append(bj); base = fit(design_mat(sel))
    changed = True
    while changed and sel:
        changed = False
        for j in list(sel):
            rest = [k for k in sel if k != j]
            if stats.chi2.sf(2 * (base - fit(design_mat(rest))), 1) > 0.01 / p:
                sel = rest; base = fit(design_mat(sel)); changed = True; break
    Z0 = design_mat(sel)
    from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
    lr = LogisticRegression(C=1e6, fit_intercept=False, max_iter=500).fit(Z0, y)
    pr = lr.predict_proba(Z0)[:, 1]; r = y - pr
    pairs = [(a, b) for a in range(p) for b in range(a, p)]
    P = np.array([X[:, a] * X[:, b] for a, b in pairs]).T
    sc = (r @ P) ** 2 / ((pr * (1 - pr)) @ (P ** 2 - P.mean(0) ** 2) + 1e-9)
    prods = []; alpha = 0.005 / len(pairs)
    for i in np.argsort(-sc)[:15]:
        a, b = pairs[i]
        if len(prods) >= 2 or any({a, b} & set(q) for q in prods): continue
        mains = sorted(set(sel) | {a, b})
        l0 = fit(design_mat(mains, prods)); l1 = fit(design_mat(mains, prods + [(a, b)]))
        if stats.chi2.sf(2 * (l1 - l0), 1) < alpha:
            prods.append((a, b)); alpha /= 5
            for k in (a, b):
                if k not in sel: sel.append(k)
    drv = [ids[j] for j in sel][:MAX_DRIVERS]
    return Design(drivers=tuple(drv), columns=tuple(ids[j] for j in sel),
                  products=tuple((ids[a], ids[b]) for a, b in prods), loadings={})
